verdict.rationale: A probe shows HubSpot's developer docs serve Markdown versions of pages (HTTP 200 on a .md URL), and each page points agents to a documentation index at /docs/llms.txt, so agent-oriented docs exist. The root /llms.txt returns 404, but the index lives under /docs/ instead. Missing for 10: direct verification that /docs/llms.txt resolves and what it contains, first-party documentation of the agent-docs offering, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt
